content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or severely restricted, digital creators face immense challenges in selling their products. The traditional reliance on these platforms often ends up being a barrier, curtailing your ability to monetize creativity. This guide reveals how to deploy a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-10|Sovereign Commerce]] digital commerce stack that enables you to sell digital products seamlessly and efficiently, without the limitations of conventional payment processors. You will learn how to set up a fully operational online store that utilizes crypto payment processing and ensures that you retain full ownership of your data. This is not just a workaround; it's a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers|COREMERCH guide to complete]]-deep-dive-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments|complete]] infrastructure solution designed for creators like you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose steep fees and restrictions that can cripple a digital creator's profitability. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, significantly cutting into your earnings. In contrast, using NOWPayments, you only incur a 0.5% fee, which means that on a $97 product with 100 sales per month, you retain an additional $921. This infrastructure is built for resilience, ensuring that creators can operate without being held back by conventional barriers. You gain complete control over your transactions, allowing you to focus on your work rather than navigating the complexities of platform dependency.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, gather the essential tools. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store, a NOWPayments account for processing crypto payments, and a Google account for managing your order storage and delivery. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, as these will enable automated delivery of your products. It's also crucial to outline the digital products you plan to sell—ebooks, courses, templates, or software—so you can efficiently structure your store. With these components in place, you're ready to build a robust selling platform.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is the backbone of your digital store. Begin by setting up your NOWPayments account, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee for transactions. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and product delivery. For product storage, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that your files are easily accessible upon purchase. Finally, integrate your payment processor with your delivery system. This setup will enable you to provide immediate access to your products while ensuring secure payment processing, creating a seamless experience for your customers.
Eliminate platform dependency and retain full control of your revenue.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is established, it's time to go live. Publish your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, allowing potential customers to access your offerings. To ensure everything functions correctly, run a test transaction using your crypto wallet. This step is crucial to confirm that your payment processor and delivery systems work together seamlessly. Following the successful test, promote your store through social media and other channels to attract your first customers. Monitor transactions closely to reinforce your setup's effectiveness and address any issues promptly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, your next step is scaling your operations. Start by analyzing your sales data to identify which products are performing best. Expand your product lineup based on customer feedback and market trends. You can also consider integrating additional payment options through NOWPayments to cater to a broader audience. As your sales grow, ensure your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions by optimizing your backend logic. This strategic approach will help you leverage your sovereign stack effectively, allowing your digital business to thrive.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. Utilize tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This setup ensures you retain full control over your sales without incurring high platform fees.
Save significantly on fees compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad.

This kit equips you with everything needed to establish and scale your sovereign digital store. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register for GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your store. Create a NOWPayments account for handling crypto transactions. Set up a Google account for order management and product delivery. Choose your digital products and prepare them for sale. Deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your payment processing and delivery systems. Run a test transaction to ensure everything works smoothly. Launch your store and start promoting it to attract customers.
